text:
Noah B: FYI landing the sample-sdk PR hit the publishguard. regen-check found a tiny typegen diff that looks like ordering-only but publishflow treats it as a minor bump.

Amira T: ugh. paste the diff?

Noah B: from packages/sdk/src/types/auto.ts:
```diff
- export type Priority = "low" | "medium" | "high";
+ export type Priority = "high" | "medium" | "low";
```
No semantic change, just union ordering.

Jules P: classic. we've hit this before. problem is twofold: 1) changelog-gen flags any typegen diff -> minor; 2) sample-app snapshot tests assume raw file text so CI parity fails downstream.

CI Bot: regen-check failed on runner: ubuntu-22.04-6, diff detected in packages/sdk/src/types/auto.ts; publishflow: blocked

Amira T: short-term mitigation suggestions: (A) relax changelog rule to run a cheap AST compare that ignores union/property order and treat those as patch, or (B) add a stable-sort postprocess to typegen so generated files are canonical. I prefer both.

Noah B: agree. immediate unblock plan: open a quick PR to make sample-app snapshots compare by parsed AST (keys/values) rather than string snapshots so downstream parity won't fail. then open a second PR with stable-sort and a unit that runs generator in CI docker.

Jules P: also saw an intermittent auth/retry flake in a different job in the same matrix (401 not retried on one runner). could be test harness ordering where env var AUTH_RETRIES is set after module import.

Amira T: repro for the retry flake?

Jules P: locally reproduced when running integration tests in a docker matrix variant where the harness exports env in the wrapper script after forking. quick fix: set AUTH_RETRIES in the test runner environment before node loads modules or make auth middleware read a runtime-config helper that tests can stub.

CI Bot: publishflow guard: blocked -> awaiting human review. Related issue: DX-2001 typegen-ordering; DX-2002 snapshot-fragility; DX-2003 auth-env-race

Noah B: action items:
- PR1 (Noah): sample-app snapshot changes -> parse+compare (to unblock)
- PR2 (Jules): typegen stable-sort + CI generator test
- PR3 (Amira): changelog-gen tweak to ignore order-only AST diffs (follow-up issue)
- PR4 (Noah): test harness fix for AUTH_RETRIES before module load

Amira T: timeline: PR1 and PR4 should be quick (under 2 hours). PR2 is a small change but want it green before we stop relying on manual overrides. PR3 is follow-up work to avoid churn in future releases.

Jules P: can someone with release privileges approve a manual override if PR1 and PR4 merge quickly? release-oncall?

release-oncall: manual override allowed if (a) PR1 and PR4 merged and (b) a follow-up ticket for changelog behavior created and linked. Please ping when ready and include the test logs.

Noah B: will open PRs now and ping #release when green. adding a quick devex blurb on autogenerated-type semver guidance so SDK authors aren't surprised.

Amira T: thanks — once we have PR2 merged I'll follow up to wire the AST comparator into changelog-gen. long-term we should have a spec: ordering-only changes = patch.

Jules P: thanks all. keeping this thread until publish is unblocked. :thumbsup:
